dct_description_sm: These areas are defined using the Water Modeling software in order to determine where the water pressure will become over 80 psi in the system and will require any service connections to the City water system to provide a PRV valve in order to maintain a pressure of below 80 PSI. This area is used within the Building and Planning Departments and created and maintained by our Utility Department.
